title: Plant-Based Producers Sustaining Romania’s Mountain Area
content: The paper continues to develop territorial profiles and present mountain producers of plant products in Romania and some models of good practices, most of the producers mentioned having an emerging character (competitors of the leaders of mountain entrepreneurship) in relation to those previously developed by the authors. The presentation consists of postulating several possible patterns for other regions or other Romanian mountain producers. The examples of good practice described aimed to present information for producers regarding the attraction of external financing and the impact on the local community in which mountain entrepreneurs carry out their activity, including their resilience in the context of mountain product exports and sustainability ensured through the internet - precision agriculture.
